main_text.p: absunt ab illo, Prov.19.7. quod potest plurale esse, per defe-ctum literæ ' ante Affixum: Plural. מְרָעִים Socii, Sodales, Jud.14.11. Vide supra in רוע.
מִרְעֶה m. Pascuum, Gen.47.4. Constr. מִרְעֵה עֲדָרִים Pascuum gregum, Jesa.32.14.
מִרְעִית f. Idem: Aff. עַם מִרְעִיתוֹ Populus pascui ejus, Psalm.95.7.
רעל Horrere, Tremere. Chaldæum est, unde רְכוּבִין דְּרַעֲלָן Genua trementia, Jes.35.3. Hoph. Præter. הָרְעֲלוּ [?] Horridè agitatæ sunt, Tremere facta sunt, Nah.2.v.3.
רַעַל m. Horror, Tremor: סַף רַעַל Ut pelvem horroris, Zach.12.2. Aben Esra, Stuporis.

רַעֲלוֹת f.p. Bracteolæ, Jesa.3.19. quæ collaribus, vittis ac peplis muliebribus addi solent; sic dicta, quòd semper Tremulæ appareant. Synecdochicè Peplum, Velum, quo faciem velant, & bracteolis ornatum esse solet: tenue etiam ac facilè mobile ac tremulum.
תִּרְעָלָה f. Horror: יַיִן תִּרְעָלָה Vinum horroris, Psal.60. v.5. Jesa.51.17.

רעם Tonare, Intonare, Fremere, Perstrepere, Personare, Commoveri, Percelli: Præt. יָרְעֲמוּ פָּנִים Percelluntur vultu, Ezech.27.35. Fut. יִרְעַם הַיָּם Perstrepet mare, Psal.96.11. Hiph.Præt. אֵל הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים Deus gloriâ intonat, Psal.29.3. Infin. בְּעֲבוּר הַרְעִימָה Ut ad fremitum commoveret eam, 1.Sam.1.6. Fut. בַּשָּׁמַיִם יַרְעַם In cœlis intonabit, 1.Sam.2.9.
רַעַם m. Tonitru, Psal.81.8. רַעַם שָׁמַיִם Tonitru princi-pum, Job.39.28. וְרַעַם גְּבוּרָתוֹ Et tonitru potentiæ ejus, Job.26.14. Aff. קוֹל רַעַמְךָ Vox tonitrui tui, Psalm.77.19.

page.notes: Hebrew forms in the vowelled entries are reproduced as far as legible at this scan resolution; vowel points are small and may be imperfect. Marked [?] where the form is doubtful (הָרְעֲלוּ, רַעַמָּה). The Latin gloss "Jesa" and "Psal" are printed with long s, rendered as Jesa and Psal. Printed "Tonitru princi-pum" retains its hyphen as printed.
